title: Key West Custom Perfume Making Class with Champagne Toast
blurb: Step into our light, island-chic fragrance lab on Duval Street to craft your own custom luxury perfume or cologne. Guided by an expert perfumer, you'll sample from a curated "organ" of over 300 premium oils, blend your signature scent drop-by-drop, and take home a full-sized 55ml bottle. Celebrate your creation with a complimentary Champagne toast in a beautifully air-conditioned sanctuary away from the Key West heat!
